decisions.reason: The air quality module is one of many low-cost building blocks in a modular system, it still had its own page in 2019, and keeping it on sale costs little while demand for indoor air monitoring keeps the option valuable.
The voltage measurement module is the current successor in a long-running product line, it fits a core measurement use, and it is cheap to keep, so there is no evidence that justifies dropping it.
The CAN bus interface serves an industrial and automotive niche that broadens the system's reach, so the option stays open at low maintenance cost.
The CO2 sensor module had prominent presentation and rising relevance for ventilation monitoring, which makes it a promising option worth keeping.
